thread:
nav: Quick sync — instrumentation roadmap status for token-cost attribution. Need milestone confirmations, final schema owner, and blockers. Owners please reply with short status. Rolling owner rotations planned for next two sprints.

jen: I own schema finalization. On track for 2026-03-31. Question — do we need per-model token splits or just per-route? I prefer per-model too but can do per-route first. @mohit any perf constraints?

mohit: Perf numbers for batch1 are in: https://go.redwood/infra/perf/attr/batch1. Tail latency spikes on KV cache miss. PR open: https://github.com/redwood/instr/pull/342 — needs review :eyes:

adrian: I'll take the ops handoff next sprint. Need docs and the rollback playbook. Who's taking canary config?

dana: I'll own canary config. Proposal: target 500 QPS, p95 <= 120ms, ramp 10% every 10m, max 20% burst. Will attach to infra PR.

jen: 500 QPS +20% for burst seems fine. Also we should include a metric to stop rollout: new error rate > 0.5% for 5m.

mohit: noticed telemetry-bot flagged staging schema mismatch earlier:
```
ERROR schema-check: token_usage v2 missing field "model_name" in event payload
```
I'll patch schema generator and re-run smoke.

sam: quick CR ping — reviewed most of #342, left one comment about join key. @mohit can you address before EOD? Otherwise I can pick up tomorrow morning.

jen: owners summary for roadmap doc: schema finalization = jen, rollout config = dana, ops handoff = adrian, perf validation = mohit, CR owner = sam. I'll update the roadmap doc after this thread.

nav: Action items: 1) mohit fix staging schema (branch token-fix-202) and run smoke; 2) dana prepare canary config gist and attach to infra PR; 3) sam + adrian coordinate rollback playbook; 4) jen merge schema by EOD Thu. Please add blockers if any.

mohit: pushing token-fix-202 now, will ping telemetry-bot to run smoke.

telemetry-bot: smoke test started for branch token-fix-202 — running schema and event integrity checks...

telemetry-bot: smoke test result: PASS — no missing fields detected :white_check_mark: (events checked: 1200)

adrian: drafting rollback playbook, will open PR with runbook and checklist shortly.

dana: created canary config gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcd1234 — assigning to infra PR #789 for attach.

jen: one more note: adding analytic tag "billing_phase" to token_usage events — will include in schema PR.

nav: perfect — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, escalate in #incidents. :thumbsup:
